finalists.label: Rheumatoid Arthritis
finalists.why: It has strong specific evidence including anti-CCP2 >300 U/mL and synovial thickening with hyperemia in multiple joints.

finalists.label: Hyperlipidemia
finalists.why: It is supported by bilateral arcus corneae and has no evidence against it.

frontier_selector.why: The presence of anti-CCP2 >300 U/mL and synovial thickening with hyperemia in multiple joints decided the final comparison in favor of Rheumatoid Arthritis.
